value.text: Yes, the HelioSync I10 can charge the Orion E4 through the GridNest W11. The charging power is limited by several factors, including the configured import policy, the available photovoltaic (PV) generation, household load, and the wallbox's maximum output, which can be up to 11 kW in grid-assisted mode. Additionally, the Orion E4 itself has a maximum AC input of 11 kW, which also limits the charging power.
